Lighting and how secure you feel from crime or harassment when you cycle.

Taking part is voluntary and you can skip any question. Your answers are not linked to your name, and no public authority receives them.

Learn more about SmartUrbanity

questions.text: When you cycle after dark, does poor street lighting change your route or when you ride?

options.text: No, it makes no difference to me
I notice it, but I don't change anything
I ride slower or keep to better-lit roads
I take a much longer, better-lit route
I don't cycle after dark because of poor lighting
I don't cycle after dark for other reasons

questions.text: During the day, do you ever feel unsafe from crime or harassment when you cycle? (Harassment includes unwanted comments, following, touching, or intimidating behaviour directed at you.)

options.text: Yes
No
Doesn't apply to me

questions.text: In the evening or after dark, do you ever feel unsafe from crime or harassment when you cycle?

options.text: Yes
No
Doesn't apply to me

questions.text: When you feel unsafe in the evening, what do you change?
questions.help: You can choose more than one answer.

options.text: I change my route
I change the time
I share my location with someone
I ask someone to come with me
I use a different means of transport
I give up going out
Nothing
Prefer not to say

questions.text: When you cycle, what makes you feel less secure from crime or harassment? (Select all that apply)

options.text: Places with few people around (isolated or deserted areas)
People behaving aggressively or in an intimidating way
Blind corners or obstructed views
Poor maintenance (e.g. abandoned buildings, graffiti, broken infrastructure)
No surveillance or security measures (e.g. no cameras, no staff)
Incidents that happened to me or were reported in the area
Overcrowded or chaotic places
Few cues to find my way without sight (e.g. no tactile paths or audio announcements)
None of these

questions.text: When you cycle, have you experienced or do you fear harassment because of who you are or how you look (e.g. gender, appearance, origin, age)?

options.text: Yes
No
Doesn't apply to me

questions.text: Do hills and slopes change how you cycle?

options.text: No, they don't affect me
I notice them, but they don't change my trip
They slow me down or tire me a lot
I avoid steep roads when I can
They limit where I can cycle

questions.text: Do signs for cyclists help you find your way?

options.text: I find my way easily, with or without signs
Signs help me now and then
I use signs to check I'm on the right route
Missing or unclear signs sometimes make me lose my way
Signs are so poor that I need my phone to find the way

questions.text: Where you go most often, is there a good place to leave your bike?
questions.help: Safe means your bike is protected from theft, for example a rack you can lock it to.

options.text: No, there is nowhere safe to leave it
There is some, but too little or too far away
Yes, but it isn't always handy or safe
Yes, I can usually find a good place
Yes, always safe and handy

questions.text: Has the lack of safe bike parking ever made you change plans or leave your bike at home?

options.text: Never
Rarely
Sometimes
Often
Always

questions.text: When you cycle, how much does traffic noise bother or annoy you?

options.text: Not at all
Slightly
Moderately
Very
Extremely

questions.text: When you cycle, what do you do when the air is bad (exhaust fumes, dust, bad smells)?

options.text: Nothing, it doesn't affect me
I notice it, but I don't change anything
I protect myself, e.g. with a mask
I take another route or travel at another time
I travel another way (e.g. by bus instead of by bike)

questions.text: When you cycle, what do you usually do when the weather is bad (rain, wind, cold or great heat)?

options.text: Nothing changes, I travel as usual
It's less pleasant, but I travel the same way
I prepare differently or change route (e.g. clothes, umbrella)
I put off or skip some trips
I travel another way (e.g. by car or bus)

questions.text: When you cycle, what do you do when streets or paths are dirty or badly kept (litter, smells, broken glass)?

options.text: It doesn't affect me
I notice it, but carry on as usual
It's unpleasant, but I still go that way
I avoid some stretches
I stop using that route altogether

questions.text: When you cycle, do pleasant or unpleasant surroundings affect how you feel?
questions.help: For example buildings, squares, how cared-for a place is and its general feel.

options.text: No, I don't pay attention to them
I notice them, but they rarely make a difference
Sometimes they affect my mood
They affect a lot how I feel on the way
I sometimes choose a route because it's nicer or more interesting
